title: Decompose the Work Lifecycle Application Layer
intent: Split WorkService into cohesive use-case services while preserving its external behavior
motivation: WorkService currently coordinates queries, lifecycle transitions, stage runs, evidence, worktrees, refresh, verification, integration, and terminalization — a central change hotspot. Non-goals: no change to lifecycle transition rules, no automatic stage advancement, no service class per function, no framework-based command bus.
ordering: Read-only behavior first, stage runs second, then evidence and Change in parallel, terminalization last, the facade to hold compatibility, lazy CLI dependencies, and ownership rules to keep the boundaries.
